title: Smile Check
concept: A phone's new 'smile check' unlock feature starts rejecting a teenager's smile — and accepting someone else's.
conflict: Leo is locked out of his own phone.
escalation: The phone unlocks when he's not touching it. Photos appear of him sleeping.
reveal: The phone isn't wrong. The face it learned during setup wasn't his — it was the thing standing behind him.
ending: 'Face recognised.' Leo hasn't looked at the screen.

hooks.line: My phone won't recognise my face anymore. It recognises someone else's.
There are photos in my camera roll of me sleeping.
hooks.first_visual: Gallery grid of dark bedroom photos.

hooks.line: Whose face did my phone learn?
hooks.first_visual: Setup screen recording, a second face blurred behind.

hooks.line: My phone unlocked by itself at 3 a.m.

originality_review: Original; avoid any real brand UI. Generic phone interface only.
